food.title: Four Classic Sadya Recipes to Bring Kerala's Onam Feast to Your Table
food.excerpt: With Thiruvonam just days away on August 26, these traditional vegetarian recipes — cabbage thoran, cheera parippu, avial, and sambar — capture the essence of Kerala's grandest meal.

food.excerpt: A fitness coach breaks down how pairing psyllium husk with cold milk, curd, lemon water or hot water targets acidity, digestion, cravings and constipation differently.

travel.title: India Drops Physical Boarding Pass Requirement for International Flights From September 1
travel.excerpt: The Bureau of Immigration will stop stamping boarding passes at all international airports, allowing travelers to use e-boarding passes on their smartphones instead.

travel.nri_angle: The change directly benefits millions of NRIs and OCI cardholders who regularly fly between India and their home countries, eliminating a long-standing friction point at departure.

travel.excerpt: After a successful pilot on the Chennai-Delhi-Frankfurt corridor that cut transit times from 60 to 20 hours, India adds six new gateways including routes to London and Copenhagen.
travel.image_caption: India is expanding its air cargo transshipment network to reduce dependence on hubs in the Middle East and Southeast Asia, targeting 80 percent growth on key trade routes.

travel.nri_angle: NRIs visiting Delhi may eventually benefit from air taxi services, though the inclusion is a planning framework entry rather than a concrete service launch.

travel.title: Why Spiritual Seekers Travel to Mount Kailash: Sadhguru's Journey Brings the Ancient Pilgrimage Into Focus

travel.title: In Meghalaya, Living Root Bridges Grow Stronger With Every Passing Year
travel.excerpt: Khasi and Jaintia villagers guide the roots of rubber fig trees across rivers for decades, creating self-healing bridges now nominated for UNESCO World Heritage status.
